info.title: Widget
info.description: Widgets let you create, update, delete, and retrieve widgets in Zoho Desk Help Center. These APIs also support filtering widgets by criteria, mapping them to help center custom themes and in-app configurations, and managing translations for different help center locales

get.description: Retrieves the translation of a single widget for one locale, identified by widgetId and locale.

get.description: Retrieves widget translations across an entire help center (helpcenterId required) for a given locale, with pagination.

parameters.description: Unique ID of the help center used to retrieve supported widgets
Number of widgets to list

parameters.description: Sorts the response by the specified field. Allowed values: createdTime, modifiedTime, name. Prefix the value with - for descending order.

parameters.name: isVisibleInHC

get.description: Lists help center widgets for a help center (helpcenterId and themeId required), with optional filters for type, page, and trashed state, and pagination.

parameters.name: widgetId
parameters.description: Deprecated parameter to get a widget by widget ID

parameters.name: helpcenterId
parameters.description: Help center ID used to get supported widgets. Note: The source says themeId should be passed when helpcenterId is provided. If helpcenterId is omitted, inAppId should be given

parameters.name: isDefault
parameters.description: Filters default widgets

parameters.name: isTrashed
parameters.description: Filters widgets by Recycle Bin state

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of widgets to list

parameters.name: themeId
parameters.description: Theme ID used to get supported widgets

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Sorts the response by the specified field. Allowed values: createdTime, modifiedTime, name. Prefix the value with - for descending order.

parameters.description: Index number starting from which widgets must be listed

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page for which widgets must be retrieved

parameters.name: inAppId
parameters.description: In-app ID used to get widgets for in-app customization

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Widget type used to filter the response. Allowed values: MARKET_PLACE_WIDGETS, CUSTOM_WIDGETS, DEFAULT_WIDGETS.

parameters.name: primaryLocale
parameters.description: Retrieves widgets for the specified master locale based on the help center locale

post.description: Creates a new help center widget. Requires name and helpcenterId; optionally accepts content, type, primaryLocale, departmentId, and help center visibility settings.
